# Parameter Reference {#sec-parameters}

Generated from the dataclasses in `DropletRelaxer.config` and
`DropletViewer.config` (the docstring below each field), with the default
values. See @sec-usage-configuration for the file format.

```{python}
#| echo: false
#| output: asis
from dataclasses import MISSING, fields

from DropletRelaxer.config import Config, _toml_value, field_docs
from DropletViewer.config import ViewerConfig


def default(f):
    if f.default is not MISSING:
        return f.default
    return f.default_factory()


def group(name, cls, intro):
    print(f"## `[{name}]`\n")
    print(intro + "\n")
    docs = field_docs(cls)
    for f in fields(cls):
        d = default(f)
        value = "(unset)" if d is None else _toml_value(list(d) if isinstance(d, tuple) else d)
        print(f"**`{f.name}`** = `{value}`\n")
        print("```text")
        print(docs.get(f.name, ""))
        print("```\n")


cfg_docs = field_docs(Config)
for g in fields(Config):
    cls = type(default(g))
    intro = (cls.__doc__ or "").strip()
    group(g.name, cls, " ".join(intro.split()) or cfg_docs.get(g.name, ""))
group("viewer", ViewerConfig, " ".join((ViewerConfig.__doc__ or "").split()))
```
